patch 8.2.3566: build failure on old systems when using nano timestamp

Problem:    Build failure on old systems when using nano timestamp.
Solution:   Define _BSD_SOURCE, _SVID_SOURCE and _DEFAULT_SOURCE. (Gary
            Johnson, closes #9054)
